decision_conditions: The development to which this permission relates must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of the decision notice. Reason: To comply with the provisions of S.51 of the Planning & Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.
The external finishing materials shall match those used in the construction of the existing building and/or areas of hard surfacing. Reason: To ensure a satisfactory appearance.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the approved plans and documents, as set out below:Pend26_200, 453_321, PP-14955344v1Reason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interests of proper planning.

The development hereby approved shall only be used for purposes ancillary to the residential use of the site dwelling and shall at no time be occupied independently as a self-contained unit.Reason: To ensure that the outbuilding does not adversely affect the amenity of adjoining residential premises and is not used for unauthorised purposes.

No development above ground level shall take place until a revised Flood Risk Assessment, including details of the proposed finished floor level(s) and surface water drainage arrangements, has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.The submitted details shall:a) demonstrate that finished floor levels will be set a minimum of 150mm above the design flood level, including climate change allowance where applicable;b) include details of the proposed means of surface water disposal, giving priority to sustainable drainage measures in accordance with the London Plan drainage hierarchy;c) demonstrate that the development will not increase flood risk on-site or elsewhere;d) include details of exceedance flows where necessary; ande) provide details of the future management and maintenance of any drainage features.The development shall thereafter be carried out in accordance with the approved details and retained as such thereafter.Reason: To ensure the development is safe from flooding, does not increase flood risk elsewhere, and provides appropriate and sustainable surface water drainage, in accordance with Policy CP28 of the Core Strategy, Policy DMD61, Policies SI12 and SI13 of the London Plan (2021) and the National Planning Policy Framework.
